notes: Monster archetypes. role: bruiser|tank|caster|ranged. classification: normal|elite|boss (wave units become elite inside challenge packs). Health = wave/challenge base x healthMultiplier (or the CombatTuning factor named by tuningKind; lane bosses also x bossHealthMultiplier). Damage is fixed per archetype (tier/wave scale health only). mesh.path is an optional /Game/ soft path (static or skeletal mesh); empty or missing falls back to the mannequin body tinted with mesh.tint. mesh.material only applies to static bodies. See Docs/NPCs.md.

abilities.name: Rusted Blade
abilities.description: A plain weapon swing at its current target.

abilities.name: Lunge
abilities.description: Marks a short line toward a distant target, then dashes along it. Step out of the line.

abilities.name: Maul
abilities.description: A heavy weapon swing at its current target.

abilities.name: Brutal Charge

abilities.name: Crushing Slam
abilities.description: Winds up a frontal cone slam. Leave the cone before it lands.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: A shield strike at its current target.

abilities.name: Challenging Roar
abilities.description: Taunts nearby champions: for 6s they deal 35% less damage to anything except the Shieldbearer. Kill or ignore it.

abilities.name: Shield Wall
abilities.description: Below 50% health, raises its shield and takes 50% less damage for 6s.

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt

abilities.name: Dark Mending
abilities.description: Interruptible 2s cast that restores 20% health to the most injured ally below 60%. Interrupt it!

abilities.name: Barbed Shot
abilities.description: Short aim, then an arrow in a fixed direction. Keeps its distance and backs away from melee.

abilities.name: Disengage
abilities.description: Leaps away when a champion reaches melee range.

abilities.name: Rain of Barbs
abilities.description: Marks a circle on its target, then a volley lands there.

abilities.name: Siege Hammer

abilities.name: Siege Stomp

abilities.name: Sundering Cleave

abilities.name: Rallying Bellow

abilities.name: Gravemaw Cleaver

abilities.name: Rallying Roar

abilities.name: Sundering Cleave
abilities.description: Winds up a 120-degree frontal cleave for heavy damage. Only the tank should stand in front.
